g.aria-label: Why Raw Throughput Lies Under Overload: Throughput vs. Goodput
Counts every token emitted regardless of wait
As arrival rate λ exceeds server saturation,
queue depth explodes and batch b swells
Raw tok/s stays pinned near 100% peak
while users wait minutes for a reply!
Rises linearly with λ up to saturation,
control as queued requests miss TTFT!
Goodput is the true production metric
Combine chunked prefill (protects TPOT), early TTFT admission rejection, and disconnect cancellation.
